en_title: ViTacFormer: Learning Cross-Modal Representation for Visuo-Tactile Dexterous Manipulation
abstract: Robotic manipulation requires fine-grained perception combining vision and touch. We present ViTacFormer, a cross-modal transformer that fuses RGB images with tactile sensor signals via shared-token attention. Pretrained on 200K teleoperation episodes and finetuned per-task with 50 demos, ViTacFormer achieves 87% success rate on a 12-task benchmark, surpassing vision-only baselines by 23 points and prior multi-modal methods by 11 points.
